title: 11 Floors, and You Enter From the Street on Most of Them | Chongqing | China Travel Expert
description:
How can an 11-storey building have a street-level entrance on almost every floor? Build it up a cliff.

Hongyadong in Chongqing is an 11-storey complex covering about 46,000㎡, built into a riverside cliff. Its form is 吊脚楼 (diaojiaolou) — traditional stilt houses held up on wooden pillars, a style native to the mountainous Bayu region where flat land is scarce, so people built upward. Honest note: today's complex is a modern reconstruction that preserves the old stilt-house form, not an ancient structure. Lit up at night, it's widely called the real-life inspiration for the bathhouse in Hayao Miyazaki's Spirited Away — though Miyazaki has never confirmed it; it's a fan consensus, not an official fact.

🧭 Expert Tip: For the classic glowing photo, cross the river to the far bank (Qiansimen bridge side) after dark — you'll frame all 11 lit tiers at once.

11层楼，贴着悬崖建，每层几乎都能从街上走进去。
